name: Aaa Authority Acceleration
headline: AAA authority acceleration: Content system
short_description: AAA Authority Acceleration System converts a single brand interview into a year's worth of authentic AI-assisted content. It benefits content creators and marketing teams by automating content generation. The system integrates with Claude Code and supports 23 modular skills for customization.
author: Zeek2Fit

sections.overview:
The AAA Authority Acceleration System solves the authenticity problem in AI content creation by converting a single brand interview into 1,900+ content pieces (12+ months worth) validated at 90-95% authenticity in blind tests. It works by loading your complete digital footprint (500k-800k tokens) to extract voice DNA, identify content boundaries through disgust mapping, and generate strategic topics that are combined into 19 different content formats. The system includes 23 modular skills covering brand discovery, voice analysis, authority positioning, competitor research, and trust-signal generation, integrated with Airtable and n8n for automated publishing across email, Twitter, WordPress, and LinkedIn.
Marketing teams automating yearly content calendars from executive interviews
Personal brands scaling authentic thought leadership without ghostwriters
Content creators generating multi-format content (long-form, social, email) from one source
Agencies delivering client content packages with consistent voice and positioning
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Zeek2Fit/aaa-authority-acceleration`
sections.usage:
```
I'm a content creator for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] brand. I've conducted a 30-minute interview with our CEO about [TOPIC]. Please use the AAA Authority Acceleration System to generate a year's worth of content from this interview, including blog posts, social media updates, and email newsletters. Ensure the content is authentic, engaging, and tailored to our target audience.
```
Copy

```
# Content Plan Based on CEO Interview
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
